name: fetch-without-timeout-hangs-forever
hook: Fetch without timeout in useEffect can hang indefinitely
body:
When a fetch request is made in a useEffect hook (like MetricsProvider's fetchMetrics), it can hang indefinitely if the server doesn't respond. This causes isLoading to stay true forever, showing a loading spinner forever.

Fix: Use AbortController with a setTimeout to abort the request after a reasonable timeout (e.g., 15s).

Why: This bug (#2574) manifested as the /admin dashboard showing 'Loading revenue & transactions...', 'Loading top products...' etc. forever because the metrics fetch to /api/admin/dashboard-metrics had no timeout.
why: This pattern (fetch + useEffect + loading state) without timeout is a common bug that manifests silently. Any component that fetches data in useEffect and has a loading state should have a timeout.
